description: Golden dataset for evaluating the summary.ai retriever pipeline. Each test case contains a query, the list of expected relevant document chunk IDs, and metadata about the expected retrieval behaviour.
notes: chunk_id is constructed as '{doc_name}::{sentence_index}' to identify which chunk should be retrieved.
expected_chunks lists ALL chunks that would be considered correct for that query.
min_relevant_in_top_k defines how many of the expected chunks should appear in top-k for the test to pass.
threshold is the minimum cosine similarity score the engine should return.

Experiments on GLUE, SuperGLUE, and SQuAD benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over baseline models.
